newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: W. Australia malting barley pool price up A$7.50t.
newsitem.headline: W. Australia malting barley pool price up A$7.50t.

text.p: The Grain Pool of Western Australia (WA) said it had increased its estimated 1996/97 malting pools prices by A$7.50 a tonne to A$219.50 a tonne.
Feed barley prices are steady on A$167.00 a tonne for premium and A$162.00 a tonne for standard grade, it said in a statement.
Chief executive officer Kevin Swan said the increase reflected the market value of malting barley against feed.
"The Grain Pool was able to sell more malting barley than was expected because of strong demand," he said.

The potential world supply of barley this year did not eventuate because two major producing countries, South Africa and Argentina, experienced drought conditions and instead of exporting their own production had to import barley for domestic use, he said.
Malting barley growers will receive the extra premium over feed with the August 29 second advance payments.
Grain Pool of WA also said that the pool price for canola had been increased by A$3.00 a tonne to A$398.00.
